01_battle_simple.prompt: In-game screenshot of a goofy physics ragdoll medieval battle game. ART STYLE IS VERY SIMPLE: characters are made of a few smooth chunky shapes, mostly solid-colored materials with almost no texture detail, soft clean shading, big simple heads with tiny dot eyes and no other facial features except an occasional simple beard shape, stubby blocky hands, slightly floppy limbs. Natural human skin tones and plain muted medieval clothing colors (oatmeal linen, brown, olive, rust, grey steel). Props are simple chunky shapes too. Environment is a little richer but still clean and stylized: smooth rolling green hills, clumps of simple stylized grass, rounded stylized trees, soft fog, bright soft sky. NOT realistic, NOT detailed textures, NOT claymation. SCENE: dozens of peasant levies with pitchforks and clubs charging into armored knights; bodies ragdolling through the air, a knight tumbling off a horse, arrows in the sky, a couple of banners. Third-person camera behind a peasant.
